subject: gk
question: As per Reserve Bank of India’s master direction, a microfinance loan is defined as a collateral-free loan given to a household having annual household income up to _____________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Rs. 3,00,000.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Reserve Bank of India, a microfinance loan is defined as a collateral-free loan given to a household having an annual household income up to ₹3 lakh.
 
• The microfinance industry’s gross loan portfolio has shown an increase of 23.5% on a yearly basis to ₹2.93 lakh crore as of June 30, 2022, from ₹2.37 lakh crore last year.
 
• Among states, Tamil Nadu is the largest state in terms of gross loan portfolio followed by Bihar and West Bengal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The microfinance industry began in India in the 1980s taking inspiration from Bangladesh.
 
• The loan growth story among credit providers has been healthy in the last year.
 
• The portfolio outstanding at NBFCs grew highest at 38.4%, microfinance NBFCs at 36.6%, small finance banks at 28.5% and banks at 9.9% during the period.

8a:T
